title: Signature SimCore: The Trick Counterpart
description: Signature SimCore is Justin Addam Higgins's original vehicle-simulation environment, the Signature counterpart to NASA Trick. Engineers write models, declare the simulation, and get a scheduled executable with recording built in — the same proven workflow, independently designed. Every piece is original Signature engineering.
provenance: Signature original: designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH) as the Signature counterpart; original engineering, labeled Signature, never presented as public record.

title: SigDefine: Declaring a Signature Simulation
description: SigDefine is the Signature simulation declaration file, the counterpart to S_define: it lists models, job ordering, rates, and recorded variables, and the Signature code generator wires it into an executable. Reconfiguring the sim means editing SigDefine. Original format, original generator.
provenance: Signature original: designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH) as the Signature counterpart; original engineering, labeled Signature, never presented as public record.

title: Signature GNC Development
description: Signature GNC algorithms are developed inside SimCore exactly the way public programs do it: guidance, navigation, and control matured against noise, dispersions, and injected failures before anything flies. The Signature filter and controller libraries are original designs with the same mathematical discipline.

title: Signature Monte Carlo
description: SimCore runs Signature Monte Carlo campaigns: randomized conditions across hundreds of runs, statistical margins out. Requirements written as percentiles get their evidence from these batches. The Signature campaign runner, statistics, and reporting are original engineering.
